origin.description: Fit a nonlinear formula by nls.lm and return the coefficients, fitted values, and convergence record.
origin.usage: nlsLM(formula, data = parent.frame(), start, jac = NULL, algorithm = "LM", control = nls.lm.control(), lower = NULL, upper = NULL, trace = FALSE, subset, weights, na.action, model = FALSE, ...)

arguments.name: formula
arguments.text: A model formula. The residual is the left side minus the right side.

arguments.name: data
arguments.text: List, data frame, or environment holding the columns.

arguments.name: start
arguments.text: Named starting values for the parameters.

arguments.name: jac
arguments.text: Optional Jacobian passed through to nls.lm.

arguments.name: control
arguments.text: Control list from nls.lm.control. trace = TRUE sets nprint to 1.

arguments.name: lower, upper
arguments.text: Optional bounds passed through to nls.lm.

arguments.name: weights
arguments.text: Optional positive weights. The minimized residual is sqrt(weights) times the response residual.

arguments.name: subset
arguments.text: Optional rows to keep before the fit.

origin.details: The formula is turned into a residual function and minimized with nls.lm. Convergence is info 1, 2, 3, or 4. The recorded tolerance is the default ftol, and residuals() is the response residual.
origin.value: An nls fit with coefficients, residuals, fitted values, deviance, weights when supplied, and convInfo.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(minpack.lm))
Treated <- Puromycin[Puromycin$state == "treated", ]
nlsLM(rate ~ Vm * conc/(K + conc), data = Treated, start = c(Vm = 200, K = 0.05))

translation.description: Fit a nonlinear formula by nls_lm and return the coefficients, fitted values, and convergence record.
translation.usage: nlsLM(formula, data, start, jac=None, algorithm="LM", control=None, lower=None, upper=None, trace=False, subset=None, weights=None, na_action="omit", model=False)

arguments.name: formula
arguments.text: A string formula. A ^ in the expression is the power operator.

arguments.name: data
arguments.text: Mapping of column names to arrays.

arguments.name: start
arguments.text: Mapping of parameter names to starting numbers.

arguments.name: jac
arguments.text: Optional Jacobian passed through to nls_lm.

arguments.name: control
arguments.text: Control dict from nls_lm_control. trace=True sets nprint to 1.

arguments.name: lower, upper
arguments.text: Optional bounds passed through to nls_lm.

arguments.name: weights
arguments.text: Optional positive weights, or a wfct expression. The minimized residual is sqrt(weights) times the response residual.

arguments.name: subset
arguments.text: Optional rows to keep. Integer positions follow R and start at 1. A boolean mask is positional.

translation.details: The formula is evaluated with the data columns and the parameters. Convergence is info 1, 2, 3, or 4. The recorded tolerance is the default ftol. residuals is the response residual, lhs minus fitted.
translation.value: An object with coefficients, residuals, fitted values, deviance, weights when supplied, and conv_info.
translation.example:
from minpacklm.nlsLM import nlsLM
from minpacklm.wfct import puromycin_treated

Treated = puromycin_treated()
print(nlsLM("rate ~ Vm * conc/(K + conc)", data=Treated, start={"Vm": 200.0, "K": 0.05}))
